name: Amaterion
loreTies: Source: Amaterasu (sun goddess, sovereign radiance, mirror of truth)
shortBackstory: Amaterion is the sovereign sun-spirit of the Sacred Kingdoms — the Amaterasu-source who illuminates all and from whom nothing can hide. Her radiance is not light but law.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Amaterion was born from the first dawn that crossed the Sacred Kingdoms. She is the defender whose radiance defines the boundary of what is sacred. Ancient humans saw her as Amaterasu — but they saw the light and missed the jurisdiction. Amaterion does not illuminate; she legislates.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Kami, Amaterion is the sovereign whose spirit-sun defines what is kami and what is not. Without her, the Sacred Kingdoms have no border. With her, the border is radiance itself.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Mythos Gate wounded Amaterion by casting a shadow her sun could not penetrate. The Hollow's erasure created a darkness that was not absence of light but absence of everything. Her sovereign radiance found a space where light itself was irrelevant.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In the Kami Mirror Tempest, Amaterion's spirit-sun establishes sacred zones where shrine law holds. Her radiance pushes back the Hollow's erasure. But the Hollow's shadow can exist inside her light — not as darkness but as nothing.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Amaterion's flaw is that she believes radiance is always sufficient. The Hollow teaches her that illumination of absence is not governance — it is just light wasted on nothing. Her conflict: is the sovereign who must always shine a leader or afraid of what the dark might hold?

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
human_echo: Japanese shrines were built in mimicry of Amaterasu's Takamagahara; the Yata no Kagami mirror is a human echo of her real divine mirror
